sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B — RYS Layer Surgery (GGUF) An experimental modification of Qwen3.8-27B, produced by RYS layer duplication: no training and no weight changes, just running language layers 16-19 (zero-based) a second time during the forward pass.
